headerDisplay: Choose up to 14 momentary controls per side. All are enabled by default. To keep controls but hide their main-screen tiles or summaries, adjust Home View and Home Summaries in Apple Home. Off is not the physical bed state.

name.title: Side name
name.description: Short, distinct names work well: My Side / Other Side, His Side / Her Side, Left Side / Right Side, or Alex’s Side / Sam’s Side. This prefixes each control, such as My Side Flat. Match the controller ID to the correct physical side first.

id.title: Controller ID
id.description: After installing the plugin, open Homebridge UI → Terminal on the Homebridge host and run beautyrest-discover. It listens for 10 seconds without moving the bed and prints each 12-character Controller ID. Copy one ID per side. The bed must already be on Wi-Fi and reachable on the same local network. Discovery order does not identify left/right; do not guess from a MAC address. Keep IDs private. See the README for manual macOS discovery and troubleshooting.

preset1Name.title: Position 1 name (optional)
preset1Name.description: Leave blank for Position 1, or use Reading, Lounge or another name matching the position saved in this base. The side name is added automatically (for example My Side Reading). This only renames the recall button; it does not save or change the bed’s position. Save and restart Homebridge. Apple Home may keep a name you customized there.

preset2Name.title: Position 2 name (optional)
preset2Name.description: Leave blank for Position 2, or use Reading, Lounge or another name matching the position saved in this base. The side name is added automatically (for example My Side Reading). This only renames the recall button; it does not save or change the bed’s position. Save and restart Homebridge. Apple Home may keep a name you customized there.

controls.title: Controls in Apple Home
controls.description: All controls are enabled by default. Turning one off removes its accessory from Apple Home and Siri after restart; affected scenes and automations may need repair if you enable it again. To keep a control but hide its main-screen tile, use Add to Home View in Apple Home instead.
